调度器决定哪个就绪任务获得 CPU。周转时间等于完成时刻减到达时刻，响应时间等于首次运行时刻减到达时刻；更早开始不一定意味着更早结束。先来先服务按到达顺序非抢占运行。最短任务优先 SJF 选择当前可用任务中运行时间最短的，并且不抢占；最短剩余时间优先 STCF 允许抢占，总是选择剩余服务时间最短的任务。使用这类策略比较时，要说明如何知道所需运行时间。

轮转调度 RR 让就绪队列中的任务轮流运行，每次最多一个时间片，尚未完成的任务回到队尾。较小时间片可改善首次响应，却增加切换频率；较大时间片可分摊切换开销，却可能延长其他任务首次运行前的等待。平均响应更小或切换占比更低，都不能单独证明某策略适合所有目标。

多级反馈队列 MLFQ 根据已经观察到的执行行为调整优先级，不要求预知准确运行时间。高优先级任务先于低优先级任务执行，同级可轮转；新任务从高优先级开始，用完 CPU 配额后降级。按累计使用量计算配额，可防止任务通过每次在时间片结束前主动让出 CPU 来永久保留高优先级。周期性提升优先级可帮助长期等待的低优先级任务。队列层数、片长、配额和提升间隔都是策略参数。

本练习另行规定一套明确模型，属于自拟教学条件：默认单处理器、独立任务、每个任务只有一个 CPU burst 且无 I/O；题目提供到达时间与服务量。切换消耗的时间不算给任何任务的 CPU 服务。提前完成的任务不消耗剩余时间片。任务恰在片尾到达时，要说明新到任务与被抢占任务谁先入队，平局也要指定顺序。

如果计算切换开销，应写明何时计费，例如只在切换到另一个任务时计费且首次派发免费，并说明切换期间到达任务如何入队；忽略开销时也须明确。可先记录每个任务首次运行与结束时刻，再计算所需指标。设计建议还需要具体目标与约束，如响应上限、开销预算或公平性。一个方案可能满足一个约束，却在另一个指标上更差。题内任务长度和预算是自拟输入，不是实测工作量，生成器标注也不是学生实测难度。

Initial dispatch and dispatch after an idle interval are free. RR boundary=before/after orders arrivals exactly at a slice end before/after the unfinished process is requeued; earlier waiting processes keep their position. during_switch=tail appends switch-time arrivals to the queue; before_preempted inserts them immediately before the just-preempted process if it is still queued, otherwise at the tail. The next process is selected before switching, and arrivals through the switch end are enqueued before it starts. early_finish_free waives the next different-process switch cost only if the previous process completed in less than a full quantum. Same-process continuation is free. STCF supports zero switch cost only and chooses (remaining time, id), including id-based preemption on equal remaining times. Id comparison is Unicode lexicographic order. switch_count counts adjacent different-process transitions, including free early-finish transitions, but excludes initial/idle dispatch. makespan is final completion measured from time zero, including initial and intermediate idle intervals. Initial dispatch and dispatch after an idle interval are free. Id comparison is Unicode lexicographic order. switch_count counts adjacent different-process transitions, including free early-finish transitions, but excludes initial/idle dispatch. makespan is final completion measured from time zero, including initial and intermediate idle intervals. Deterministic single-processor RR or STCF scheduling with independent, single-burst processes and no I/O. Times are integer abstract time units. Initial dispatch and dispatch after an idle interval are free. RR boundary=before/after orders arrivals exactly at a slice end before/after the unfinished process is requeued; earlier waiting processes keep their position. during_switch=tail appends switch-time arrivals to the queue; before_preempted inserts them immediately before the just-preempted process if it is still queued, otherwise at the tail. The next process is selected before switching, and arrivals through the switch end are enqueued before it starts. early_finish_free waives the next different-process switch cost only if the previous process completed in less than a full quantum. Same-process continuation is free. STCF supports zero switch cost only and chooses (remaining time, id), including id-based preemption on equal remaining times. Id comparison is Unicode lexicographic order. switch_count counts adjacent different-process transitions, including free early-finish transitions, but excludes initial/idle dispatch. makespan is final completion measured from time zero, including initial and intermediate idle intervals. Consecutive run intervals for the same process without an intervening switch/idle interval are merged.

Deterministic single-processor RR or STCF scheduling with independent, single-burst processes and no I/O. Times are integer abstract time units. Initial dispatch and dispatch after an idle interval are free. RR boundary=before/after orders arrivals exactly at a slice end before/after the unfinished process is requeued; earlier waiting processes keep their position. during_switch=tail appends switch-time arrivals to the queue; before_preempted inserts them immediately before the just-preempted process if it is still queued, otherwise at the tail. The next process is selected before switching, and arrivals through the switch end are enqueued before it starts. early_finish_free waives the next different-process switch cost only if the previous process completed in less than a full quantum. Same-process continuation is free. STCF supports zero switch cost only and chooses (remaining time, id), including id-based preemption on equal remaining times. Id comparison is Unicode lexicographic order. switch_count counts adjacent different-process transitions, including free early-finish transitions, but excludes initial/idle dispatch. makespan is final completion measured from time zero, including initial and intermediate idle intervals. Consecutive run intervals for the same process without an intervening switch/idle interval are merged.

Deterministic single-processor RR or STCF scheduling with independent, single-burst processes and no I/O. Times are integer abstract time units. Initial dispatch and dispatch after an idle interval are free. RR boundary=before/after orders arrivals exactly at a slice end before/after the unfinished process is requeued; earlier waiting processes keep their position. during_switch=tail appends switch-time arrivals to the queue; before_preempted inserts them immediately before the just-preempted process if it is still queued, otherwise at the tail. The next process is selected before switching, and arrivals through the switch end are enqueued before it starts. early_finish_free waives the next different-process switch cost only if the previous process completed in less than a full quantum. Same-process continuation is free. STCF supports zero switch cost only and chooses (remaining time, id), including id-based preemption on equal remaining times. Id comparison is Unicode lexicographic order. switch_count counts adjacent different-process transitions, including free early-finish transitions, but excludes initial/idle dispatch. makespan is final completion measured from time zero, including initial and intermediate idle intervals. Consecutive run intervals for the same process without an intervening switch/idle interval are merged.

各进程彼此独立，只有一次 CPU 服务且无 I/O；使用单处理器和整数抽象时间单位。同时到达按进程 ID 字典序入队。首次调度、空闲后的调度和同一进程连续执行均无切换开销。响应时间=首次开始时刻−到达时刻；周转时间=完成时刻−到达时刻。最终完成时刻从 t=0 计，包含所有空闲和切换时间。进程切换次数计相邻不同进程的转换，包含免费转换，不含首次或空闲后的调度。时间线使用左闭右开区间；没有切换或空闲隔开的同进程运行区间合并显示。

进程（到达时刻，服务时间）：

P1: (0, 7)

P2: (2, 4)

P3: (4, 9)

P4: (6, 3)

S1: STCF；切换开销为 0。每个整数时刻在已到达且未完成的进程中，依次按剩余服务时间、进程 ID 字典序选最小者；剩余服务时间相等时，ID 较小者也会抢占当前进程。

S2: RR；时间片 q=2，不同进程间切换开销=1。运行片段结束前到达的进程先入队；恰在片段结束时刻到达的进程，排在刚重新入队的未完成进程之前，原有等待者保持次序。切换前已选定下一进程；切换期间（含结束时刻）到达的进程追加到队尾，随后才开始执行已选定进程。仅当前一进程在刚结束的运行片段中完成，且该片段长度严格小于时间片时，免除随后切换到不同进程的开销。

S3: RR；时间片 q=6，不同进程间切换开销=1。运行片段结束前到达的进程先入队；恰在片段结束时刻到达的进程，排在刚重新入队的未完成进程之前，原有等待者保持次序。切换前已选定下一进程；切换期间（含结束时刻）到达的进程追加到队尾，随后才开始执行已选定进程。仅当前一进程在刚结束的运行片段中完成，且该片段长度严格小于时间片时，免除随后切换到不同进程的开销。

对每个方案，给出完整时间线、各进程首次开始时刻/响应时间/完成时刻/周转时间、平均响应时间、平均周转时间、切换次数、切换总开销和最终完成时刻。平均值保留精确分数。

在 S1 中，t=10 时 P1 还剩多少 CPU 服务量？只计 [0, 10) 内已执行的服务；未到达的进程也保留其全部服务量。

在 S3 中，t=20 时 P3 还剩多少 CPU 服务量？只计 [0, 20) 内已执行的服务；未到达的进程也保留其全部服务量。

在满足「最终完成时刻 <= 26 且 切换总开销 < 7」的方案中，选择平均响应时间最小的方案，逐项说明约束判断；并列最优时列出全部方案，无可行方案时明确说明。
